question: As per the Union Budget 2021-22, Mission Poshan 2.0 is proposed to be launched to improve nutritional outcomes across _______ aspirational districts.
solution:
The correct answer is __**112**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the **Union Budget 2021-22 **intensified strategy to improve nutritional outcomes across **112 aspirational districts** is proposed under **Mission Poshan 2.0.**
 
• To strengthen nutritional content, delivery, outreach, and outcome, the Supplementary Nutrition Programme and the Poshan Abhiyaan were merged to launch Mission Poshan 2.0.
 
• Poshan 2.0 scheme is an** umbrella scheme covering the Integrated Child Development Services.**
 
• Implementation of this program will be done by the **Ministry of Women and Child Development** in collaboration with the** Ministry of Health and Family Welfare** and the **Ministry of Education under the aegis of Early Childhood Care and Education (ECCE)** within the National Education Policy (NEP)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Poshan Abhiyan is the** Indian government’s flagship programme to improve nutritional outcomes for children, pregnant women and lactating mothers**.
 
• Its first phase was launched in **March 2018 by the Prime Minister in Jhunjhunu, Rajasthan**.
 
• **Malnutrition** refers to deficiencies, excesses or imbalances in a person’s intake of nutrients.
